description: Characterization baselines for the Issue 11 fault-injection matrix. Scenarios with status 'failing' reproduce the fault but the production fix is not yet implemented; update the baseline to 'passing' when the fix lands.

scenarios.name: storage-identity-contradiction
scenarios.description: Manifest declares layout 7 (SQLite WAL) but yui.db does not exist. With readable state.json this is pseudo-layout-7 (needs-repair, degraded); without state.json it is no-authoritative-backend (contradiction, fail).
scenarios.expected: pseudo-layout-7 needs-repair when state.json is readable; no-authoritative-backend contradiction when it is not

scenarios.name: provider-500-then-recover
scenarios.description: AgentRun summaries containing StopFailure 500/504/connection-lost/rate-limit must classify as provider-transient with basis text-historical.

scenarios.name: yield-crash-before-commit
scenarios.description: A yielded AgentRun without deliveredAt (Controller crashed before the durable acceptance fold) must still be counted as yielded by the audit. The production state machine should eventually distinguish uncertain yields; the audit currently counts them uniformly.
scenarios.expected: audit should flag yielded-without-deliveredAt as delivery-yield-uncertain
scenarios.actual: audit counts all yielded runs uniformly; no uncertain-yield distinction yet

scenarios.name: yield-crash-after-commit
scenarios.description: A yielded AgentRun with deliveredAt (Controller crashed after the durable acceptance fold) must be counted as a clean yield.

scenarios.name: pane-dead-provider-alive
scenarios.description: When a tmux pane is dead but the Provider child process survives, the resource inventory must detect the residual process tree. Full attribution requires the sandbox-home acceptance with fake residual processes.
scenarios.expected: inventory attributes residual Provider tree to the dead pane's owner
scenarios.actual: inventory scanner runs and returns structured resources; residual-tree attribution verified in sandbox-home acceptance only

scenarios.name: unchanged-scheduler-scan-x100
scenarios.description: 100 scheduler.signal calls with no state change must not create any new Leader AgentRun.

scenarios.name: handover-candidate-failure
scenarios.description: An IntegrationAttempt with a conflict (stale base target) must classify as stale-base-target-cas with basis structured.

scenarios.name: archive-live-reference-fail-closed
scenarios.description: An archived Task with an active AgentRun must be surfaced by the audit so the contradiction is visible. The production archive flow should fail closed on live references; the audit currently reports the state without blocking.
scenarios.expected: archive flow should refuse to archive a Task with active runs
scenarios.actual: audit surfaces active=1 on archived task; archive flow does not yet block
